node.statement: Apply the scalar naturality clause of lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality to the polar data (delta,S_delta,u_delta,h_delta) and to X=Z_t: since X and cX lie in S_delta, u_delta(cZ_t)=c*u_delta(Z_t). With the scaled-path identity, this is H(t,cU_0,cU_1)=c*H(t,U_0,U_1).
